==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I befriended a Were-Goldfish named Johnson. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.)
Johnson revealed to me that there is an entire underwater society living under one of the bridges in the village. (Were-Fish Society resembles an underwater city made up of glowing, orange, glass, dome shaped pods. There are orange roadways that weave throughout the city, that allow for cars to navigate between the underwater domes. This entire society secretly exists in the water beneath one of the bridges in the Elven Village.)
I had a fun time racing Johnson on an underwater race track. (I raced Johnson in a car made of Lucid Light. Johnson didn't use a car at all, and just swam on the racetrack. Despite not having a car, Johnson won the race. That's just how fast of a swimmer he is.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
